target_customer: Large enterprises with global supply chains in fashion, consumer goods, manufacturing, food and beverage and financial institutions, plus sustainability consultants
problem: Companies hold operational and accounting data that is not in carbon form, so measuring and reporting supply chain emissions is slow and spreadsheet heavy.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS subscription for carbon footprint and sustainability reporting
product_category: Carbon accounting and sustainability data management

founders.name: Grace Sai
previous_startups: Earlier startup as founder, details not sourced
founders.background_notes: Former founder and venture capitalist, Kauffman Fellow, per YC page; Tatler profile calls her a serial entrepreneur

founders.name: Marc Allen
founders.background_notes: Chemical engineer with over 20 years of experience, hydrogen facilities, climate and sustainability advisory since 2007

investors: Surge (Sequoia India and Southeast Asia, lead)

competitors.name: Persefoni
competitors.what: Carbon accounting software replacing spreadsheets and consultants
competitors.funding_then: 101M Series B in 2021, per company framing

competitors.name: Watershed
competitors.what: Enterprise carbon platform, strong for complex supply chains

competitors.name: SAP and Salesforce
competitors.what: Software giants that announced carbon measuring tools

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping messy accounting and operational data to emissions factors and supply chain footprints using ML is standard data engineering with hard classification and data quality work.

defensibility.rationale: Crowded category with well funded rivals and software giants; data integration and emissions factor mapping give some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SAP and Salesforce had announced carbon tools, but Unravel remained independent through at least 2026.

market_need_then: Regulation and investor pressure for ESG and ISSB reporting grew in 2021 and 2022, and press described companies racing to count emissions ahead of SEC climate rules.

branding.community_and_virality: Founder profiles in Tatler Asia and Robb Report Singapore; no fan community evidence

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name that fits the unravel data idea (the link is not stated by a source), and founder press helped awareness in Singapore; no evidence of brand-driven growth.

outcome_analysis: Unravel Carbon was founded in September 2021, joined YC in Winter 2022, raised a 7.38M seed led by Surge in May 2022, and by the YC page reached 42 people and use in 48 countries. Regulatory tailwinds and experienced founders helped; a crowded category with funded rivals is the main risk.
notes: Seed confirmed by Alpha JWC, DealStreetAsia and Asia Tatler. CB Insights lists a 1M seed III in September 2025 and 11.8M total over 8 rounds; one aggregator only, so unverified and not recorded. A 7M Series A in April 2025 under the name Unravel is a different company. Competitor dating is loose: sources were roundups, not 2022 launch coverage. No outcome news found.
